result:
Everything is in place and left uncommitted as requested. Summary of the change:

- **`crates/smysl-provider/src/usage.rs`**: added `Ledger::default_path()`, which resolves `~/.smysl/usage.log` via `HOME` (falling back to `USERPROFILE` on Windows), returning `None` when neither is set. `Ledger::PATH` is kept as-is for project-scoped use and tests. Added a test covering the `HOME`/`USERPROFILE` precedence and the "no home" case.
- **`src/main.rs`**: added a `ledger_path()` helper used by both `cmd_ingest` and `cmd_usage` — it prefers `Ledger::default_path()` and falls back to the old project-relative path only if no home directory can be found, since the ledger is informational and a call must still be recorded somewhere.
- **`tests/dispatch.rs`**: pointed `HOME`/`USERPROFILE` at each test's scratch directory so the dispatch tests can't write to the real machine's home directory, and updated the stale comment.
- **`Documentation/manual/ch09-10-attest-providers.typ`**: updated the usage-ledger prose and example paths from the project-local `.smysl/usage.log` to `~/.smysl/usage.log`.

Verified manually that two separate project directories sharing one fake `$HOME` now accumulate into the same ledger, and confirmed `cargo test -q -p smysl --tests --no-fail-fast` and `cargo test -q -p smysl-core --no-fail-fast` both pass (also spot-checked `smysl-provider`'s own tests).
